messages:
Sam L: Quick async standup for slowstart canary (v2.1). Please post what you did / blockers / today. Canary = 3% eu-west traffic. If you see error rate >2% or p95 >220ms ping @eng-sre. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/canary/slowstart-v2 Thanks :wave:

Maria G: What I did: moved feature-flag rollout to slice B, validated session routing. Blockers: saw a short 503 spike at 03:12 — investigating upstream timeouts. Today: will repro under load and run heap dump if it repeats.

Devon K: Metrics: p50 42ms, p95 jumped to 280ms during the spike. Error rate peaked at 3.8% for ~90s. Captured proxy logs and started local repro. Snippet of error in logs:
```json
{"level":"error","msg":"upstream timeout","service":"cache","req_id":"abc123"}
```

Javier: Saw same. Kicked a restart for canary-backend-3, memory went from 1.8G -> 1.2G after. Watching GC. Also rolled a transient iptables rule; no change. Sharing perf chart: https://dash.redwood.ai/charts/canary-p95?range=1h

Priya R: Product check — any user-visible degradation? If not, we'll keep the 3% but hold further ramps.

Maria G: No user 5xx via Sentry; internal health checks fired. :eyes: I'll keep watch and set an alert if >1% for next 10m. Also requeued canary jobs.

Tina.ops.bot: deploy-bot: canary v2.1 rollout started 03:05 by Devon K — status: partially rolled (3%).

Devon K: Plan: run targeted load test against eu-west canary instances at 04:00. If no regressions, we bump to 10% tomorrow morning; otherwise rollback to v2.0. @Maria G can you attach heap dump if spike returns?

Maria G: Yup — I have the dump script ready: `kubectl exec -it $POD -- jmap -dump:format=b,file=/tmp/heap.hprof PID`

Sam L: Thanks. I'll update the rollout doc and set a 15m follow-up here at 04:20. If anyone sees repeat spikes, react with :rotating_light: and tag @eng-oncall.

Javier: +1. Also added a temp alert on p95 > 250ms for canary only.

Tina.ops.bot: alert: p95 canary eu-west breached 250ms at 03:13 — resolved at 03:15.

Devon K: FYI I've opened CR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/infer/+/1234 with the retry tweak. @Sam L please review when you have a sec.

Sam L: Reviewing now, should be done by EOD. :thumbsup:

Maria G: No further spikes last 20m. Will call it stable for now and leave the 3% slice.

Priya R: Thanks team. I'll hold on ramp requests until morning. :raised_hands:
